mql4.license: Inventory has no LICENSE. Startup print claims MIT, but no permission notice is established; do not copy unlicensed source as MIT.
findings: MQL4 series index0 is current incomplete bar; idx-1 is newer, not chronological prior. Source VM uses High[idx]-Low[idx-1] and Low[idx]-High[idx-1] while TR uses chronological older Close[idx+1]. Preserve this asymmetry or explicitly reject, never silently textbook-correct.

VI[1] includes bar0 high/low via idx1. Code runs signal calculation on first newbar tick only (and startup first tick). At that observation bar0 contains only observed ticks; reconstructing it with eventual completed OHLC would leak future data. A first-tick proxy would need explicit declared quote/timestamp mapping and would be an adaptation.

Current EMA is index1, prior EMA index2, strict crossings and rising winning EMA are required. It is not cinar state signal and must not count as an independent textbook Vortex strategy without overlap disclosure.

Seed chooses oldest index where both VI>0; EMA recurrence walks toward zero. Second loop walks toward older indexes. Under default oldest-valid selection all older VI are invalid; it copies seed into old slots and does not necessarily contaminate current EMA. Do not simplify source without fixture evidence. Full chart-history length and seed must be pinned.
Default 30bars and EMA10 transfer to240h/80h only if chart timeframe explicitly selected. Source uses current chart rather than an explicit 8h timeframe.

Entries buy Ask/sell Bid; spread gate occurs before reversals. Fixed lots rounded to broker lotstep/min/max and two decimals. Stop/target distances depend on Point/Digits and MODE_STOPLEVEL, including minimum distance max(2*stopLevel,10*Point). No dimension conversion to crypto percentages is justified by source.

Tick trailing and break-even act in order trailing then break-even; OrderModify may reject too-close stops against both Bid/Ask. Quote sequence, intraminute path, rejects and refreshed quotes influence realized state. 8h/minute Spot OHLCV cannot establish native parity.

Signal time marked consumed before spread/execution success; no samebar retry after failed admission except internal order retry loop. Opposite reversal closes one matching ticket, waits100ms and refreshes quotes, then opens opposite only if no existing same-side flag. Native bidask/tick/broker lifecycle absent.
